note: All written reviews the Play page shows (20; the page lists 51 ratings). Collected in the built-in browser by opening See all reviews and scrolling until no more loaded. Reviewer names omitted.

reviews.text: I've entered a couple of tasks and so far I really like the app. It's extremely helpful for some like me to organize tasks for people willing to help. Unfortunately, whenever I try to add a location to a task, I search for and find the location, but then the app kicks me out. I've tried it both with and without location services on. Help? BTW a helpful option to consider might be to let the user add or customize a couple of task categories.

You can not edit any notes or announcements if you mispelled a word. You can not edit pictures or albums if you want to move or remove a picture and it only uploads one picture at a time. There is no calendar or daily check-in for a place for medications. Terrible app all the way around.

Not great but it has potential and needs a massive facelift. Things that need work include: -Accepting new members is hidden in the back settings (which I find odd, just have members a tab and have that also underneath the umbrella?) -Trying to edit existing tasks on the app (such as if ppl switch which tasks they're doing) is basically like building an airplane. Overall, an app should be easier and more intuitive to use than the website. Currently it's not, so hope you'll make improvements.

I recently upgraded my phone to a Google Pixel 6 Pro and the Lotsa app legitimately has not launched one time on my phone. I have restarted my phone, uninstalled and reinstalled the app, and nothing works. Recently I tried to keep the app uninstalled for a few days and restart my phone daily. Still nothing. I have an account and am a part of a support group. The app was installed on my last phone -the Google Pixel 3- when I first downloaded Lotsa. I just found out about the website for use.
The idea is fantastic. The website definitely works better than the app. Please keep up development because we are using this to coordinate support!

I love the service and loved the app...but upgraded to a pixel 6 and it won't launch. Are you guys updating the app? I will update the review if so! Thx! I edited my review because I dont want to bring your review scores down!! Hoping to have it fixed soon given I'm on the go a lot and the app is really useful!!!

Love this app The website is much harder to navigate and use, but this app is the bomb and it is soo effective to manage all of our volunteers. I have 2 communities with over 200 volunteers and they can assign themselves, have access to the place they are to be and contact me if there are issues. I do not care for the website at all as it's hard to see the volunteers and change. But this app makes it so easy .the announcements and communications is fantastic..the volunteers love the email reminders with the maps...I could not go without this app. Thank you for creating it!!!!
